scenario: Studio desktop client, focused, 60 FPS. Local player is a participant on Arena 1; bot matches on Arenas 2-7 (7 simultaneous fights). Measured by FightClientDev Profile (os.clock around each FightView:Render) over 5 s windows, mid-round.

before.snapshotPayload: table snapshot, ~746 bytes each when JSON-encoded (Roblox's own encoding is somewhat smaller), 20 Hz per fight in range

after.snapshotPayload: 128-byte buffer (SnapshotCodec), measured 5,120 B/s for 2 fights in range at 20 Hz

changes: Highlights enabled only while a power tint is visible
No surface-crack Parts for scenes the player is not viewing (sub-pixel at spectator distance)
Binary FightSnapshot payload with a numeric fight key instead of the id string
caveats: Desktop Studio numbers; not a phone measurement. Real low-end phone MicroProfiler check remains an owner action.
Earlier ~15 FPS client samples coincided with an unfocused/minimized Studio window (throttled), not game cost.
